item.title: COVID-19, forcing an audible on Peter’s research
item.description: Prior to COVID-19 Life before COVID-19 in some ways seems a lifetime ago, but it was less than two weeks ago that research, work, and life in general were running smoothly. I was dropping my son off at daycare, going to work every day, and able to buy toilet paper whenever I wanted. I was finally starting to make some progress on my project trying to find new treatments for the rare pediatric lung cancer, Pleuropulmonary Blastoma, or PPB.
